subject: general
question: Why do cars have treaded tyres?

options.text: To increase friction and grip on the road

solution:
The correct answer is __To increase friction and grip on the road__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Treaded tyres__ are designed to enhance road grip and traction.
 
• The tread patterns on tyres help channel water away from the contact surface during wet conditions.
 
• They prevent slippage and improve braking efficiency.
 
• Increased friction and grip contribute to better stability and control of the vehicle.
 
• These tyres are crucial for safety, especially on wet or uneven roads.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Smooth tyres:**
 
 
• Smooth tyres are used in racing for maximum contact with dry surfaces.
 
• They lack tread patterns, which reduces grip in wet conditions.
 
 
 
• **Winter tyres:**
 
 
• Designed for snowy or icy conditions, these tyres have deeper treads.
 
• They provide enhanced traction on slippery surfaces.
 
 
 
• **Off-road tyres:**
 
 
• These tyres have aggressive tread patterns for dirt, mud, and uneven terrains.
 
• They are designed for durability and maximum grip in extreme conditions.
